purpose: Registration #3785 / release #3072 / SSH attestation #4445: determine whether the pre-existing pc-prod tai-readonly self-hosted GitHub Actions runner is online, offline or busy while the read-only host-key attestation is pending.
requiredBehavior: execute only on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner during pull_request
use only the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN with actions read and contents read permissions
read the repository self-hosted runner inventory through the GitHub Actions API
select only runners carrying both pc-prod and tai-readonly labels
publish only runner name, online/offline state, busy flag and labels
perform no production connection and no production mutation
forbiddenCapabilities: SSH or network connection to production
repository or organization secret reads beyond the implicit ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN
secret mutation, runner mutation, registration token creation or runner removal
Docker, database, deploy, migration, service restart, MFA, password reset or mail mutation
new paid provider, SaaS subscription or recurring cost
acceptanceEvidence: workflow syntax and project lock pass
hosted job reports exactly one pc-prod+tai-readonly runner or fails closed on cardinality
runner status evidence contains no secrets and production mutation remains NONE
